gen-dafont-bloody-fs-plein: Plein is a plain sans with a clear channel leading into each round letter, and it keeps its manner reliable and tidy. Bloody earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-roundo: Roundo reads as a plain sans, geometric, with each n built from an arch and stem that match. Bloody brings commanding, tall lowercase bowls, and Roundo's small counters stay unclogged beneath them, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-spline-sans: Approachable, that's Spline Sans, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Over a longer stretch its vertical and horizontal strokes carry identical weight, so the text runs smooth and contemporary beneath Bloody's big round bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-fs-synonym: Synonym reads dependable, a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve. And Bloody's commanding round bowls sit above it, taller in the lowercase, so the heading shouts while the sans keeps the text steady.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-almendra: Dark, dramatic, a little theatrical: Bloody's big round bowls make the first impression. Almendra follows with a dignified, bookish serif and a deep midsection in its lowercase, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-bree-serif: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls are the first thing you notice. Bree Serif, a literary text serif with outsized lowercase proportions, carries a longer stretch of reading with a refined, friendly confidence.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-port-lligat-slab: Port Lligat Slab has lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, and its open-ended curves have room to breathe. Bloody does commanding display work with big round bowls; Port Lligat Slab does the literary, traditional text work.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-quando: Heavy, round and a bit menacing, Bloody sets the tone with big bowls. Quando answers in a traditional, bookish serif with sparse, wide spacing, so a longer passage would move slowly and openly.
gen-dafont-bloody-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves finishing well before they close, like cable bent into shapes. Bloody earns its keep big and brief, where its commanding round bowls can do the talking.
gen-dafont-bloody-plus-jakarta-sans: Precise and modern, Plus Jakarta Sans keeps a monoline build with curve endings held well apart. Bloody sits above it, commanding and round, while Plus Jakarta Sans supplies the steady text underneath.
